question: With the published exchanger network represented (WI-092), how much of the remaining unremoved heat and gross/net shortfall at the source-supported inputs is removed, how the result depends on the supplied split, whether a steady all-checks revised reference case exists at the 1600 kg/s convention, and what the separately declared resized-compressor alternative gives at 1700 and 1800 kg/s; with the original failing case and the round-1 series cases retained as controls.

axes.basis: Raffray Table III prints 0.95; the inherited 0.8 is agent assumption A3. Values 0.8 and 0.95.
axes.missing_response: No purchased recuperator geometry, area or pressure-loss relation resists the effectiveness.

axes.basis: Inherited 1400 kg/s is agent assumption A3; 1600 is derived from Lyon 2916 MW over Raffray Fig. 12 cycle temperatures 355 to 707 C at cp 5193 (1595 kg/s); 1500/1700/1800/2000 bracket the response.
axes.missing_response: No machine map, purchased flow capability or cycle pressure-loss law responds to cycle flow; compressor rating screen is the only reachable check.

axes.basis: Raffray Table V prints 283 kg/s; inherited 500 kg/s is agent assumption A4.
axes.missing_response: Divertor hydraulics and MHD are unqualified; the cubic pump proxy is bypassed by the fixed-power mode in every case that changes this flow.

axes.basis: Diagnostic tenfold conductance (UA 50 to 500 MW/K) to separate conductance limits from temperature and capacity-rate limits; labelled resized diagnostic, never reference reproduction.
axes.missing_response: U has no geometry or pressure-drop qualification.

axes.basis: Same diagnostic as he_u.
Same diagnostic as he_u.
Lyon reference is an ignited plasma (P_input = 0, p707); inherited 20 MW is assumption A1.
axes.missing_response: No plasma sustainment model resists this supplied heat.

axes.basis: Lyon p717 itemises 5 MW cryogenic; inherited 10 MW is assumption A5.
Lyon itemises no control load; folded into the 50 MW balance of plant.
Lyon p717: 50 MW balance of plant.
Lyon itemises no fuel-processing load; folded into balance of plant.
Same as fuel_base_load.
Mode 1 supplies a fixed pump power instead of the cubic proxy; used to hold or set pump power explicitly.
Lyon p708: 170 MW blanket helium pumping; Raffray Table II: 156 MW.
Mode 1 supplies a fixed pump power instead of the cubic proxy.
Lyon p708 and Raffray Table V: 27 MW divertor helium pumping; inherited 10 MW is assumption A2.

Model meaning: fraction of charged power deposited in the blanket circuits, remainder to the divertor. Inherited 0.25 is assumption A1. Lyon Table IV prints 98.1 MW to the divertor of 487 MW charged power; Raffray Table V implies 66.8 MW of nuclear heating in the divertor at 2365 MW (186 minus 24 friction, 23.6 conducted, 23.6 alpha loss, 48 radiated), 68.8 MW scaled to 2436 MW. Divertor deposition 167 MW gives 1 minus 167/487.2 = 0.657; the nuclear share is carried as charged power because the model has no divertor nuclear-heating term.
axes.missing_response: No radiation, scrape-off-layer or neutron transport model resists the partition.

axes.basis: Raffray Table II: 111 MW conducted from PbLi to He at 2365 MW fusion, 0.0469 of fusion power; inherited 0.04 is assumption A1.
axes.missing_response: No insert-conductance model resists the exchange.

axes.basis: Mode 0 is the inherited series arrangement (helium, then divertor, then PbLi in one cycle stream; WI-089). Mode 1 represents Raffray Fig. 12 (p. 741): the blanket-helium exchanger first, then the PbLi and divertor-helium exchangers in parallel on split cycle flow, rejoining before the turbine (WI-092 design, reviewed).
axes.missing_response: No branch hydraulic balance, header or pressure-loss law resists the arrangement; the split between the parallel stages is supplied.

axes.basis: Fraction of cycle flow through the PbLi stage in mode 1; no source states it. Raffray duty shares (1444 MW PbLi, 186 MW divertor; Tables II and V) imply about 0.89 for equal branch temperature rises; the design default is 0.85; 0.50 to 0.98 brackets the response. Ignored in mode 0.
axes.missing_response: No valve, header or branch hydraulic model responds to the split; a split that starves a branch shows as unmet heat on that branch, never as manufactured transfer.

axes.basis: Inherited 1600 MW offered compressor capacity is assumption A6 (WI-089). The separately named resized-compressor alternative sets the rating to 1700 or 1800 MW alongside the same cycle flow; it is a declared hardware change studied for its purpose and never a reference reproduction.
axes.missing_response: No compressor map or purchase-cost response; the rating is the scalar offered-capacity screen against the calculated compressor demand.
